rationale: S-0088-01 proposes a causal NaP-knockout ablation per cluster representative (4 cells x 16 directions, ~64 min local CPU, $0) to confirm NaP as the dominant PD-vs-ND mechanism. t0090 (morphology generator + diversity test) covers this scope in Phase G as part of the bundled validation triplet. The validation bundle sharpens the biological-plausibility interpretation of t0091's morphology-extended Pareto front. Rejecting as covered.
